From: Dana Whitfield
Subject: Q3 invoice and next steps

Hi,

Attached is the Q3 invoice for 4,250 dollars, due on October 15th. Two things before then: please confirm the new billing address, and let me know whether you want the maintenance plan renewed for another year at the same rate.

Also, the site migration is scheduled for the weekend of the 4th. Expect about two hours of downtime on Saturday night.

Thanks,
Dana
